en.title: Backend Developer
en.stack: Node.js, NestJS, AWS, REST APIs, Microservices, API Gateway

items: Designed and built server-side logic that answers front-end requests quickly.
Built modular, maintainable services with Node.js and NestJS.
Designed and developed REST APIs for the communication between client and server.
Built and orchestrated a microservices architecture, with API Gateway routing the requests.
Implemented and managed the cloud infrastructure on AWS.
